param.description:
Param configuration to extract the {@link ReliabilityApplicationState#showSwapAssetAffectedSensorGrid},
which determines whether affected sensors exist to be displayed.

Example:
```
"type": "SwapAssetClassGridSwitchRenderer",
"param": {
  "type": "UiSdlApplicationStateValueParam",
  "id": "Reliability.ReliabilityApplicationState",
  "path": "showSwapAssetAffectedSensorGrid"
}
```

title:
Determines whether the SwapAssetAffectedSensorsGrid should be displayed based on application state.

- If {@link ReliabilityApplicationState#showSwapAssetAffectedSensorGrid} evaluates to true,
  the `affectedSensorsExists` value is returned, signaling that the affected sensors grid should be displayed.
- Otherwise, the `default` value is returned, indicating no affected sensors to show.

The `condition` is used by #useSwitchCondition to dynamically switch between these SDL components.
name: SwapAssetClassGridSwitchRenderer
